hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Europe, east of France, north of Italy || mostly mountains (Alps in south, Jura in northwest) with a central plateau of rolling hills, plains, and large lakes || landlocked; crossroads of northern and southern Europe; along with southeastern France, northern Italy, and southwestern Austria, has the highest elevations in the Alps || Resources: hydropower potential, timber, salt || Exports: gold, packaged medicine, vaccines, nitrogen compounds, base metal watches (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountains (Alps in south, Jura in northwest) with a central plateau of rolling hills, plains, and large lakes || Central Europe, east of France, north of Italy

climate.excerpt: temperate, but varies with altitude; cold, cloudy, rainy/snowy winters; cool to warm, cloudy, humid summers with occasional showers || avalanches, landslides; flash floods

economy.excerpt: high-income, non-EU European economy; top ten in GDP per capita; renowned banking and financial hub; low unemployment and inflation; slowed GDP growth post-pandemic; highly skilled but aging workforce; key pharmaceutical and precision manufacturing exporter; leader in innovation and competitiveness indices || Exports: gold, packaged medicine, vaccines, nitrogen compounds, base metal watches (2023) || Industries: machinery, chemicals, watches, textiles, precision instruments, tourism, banking, insurance, pharmaceuticals
